name: scoobynko-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: live panes, animations and tweaks that hot-reload inside your session.

plugins.name: clawd-spinner
plugins.description: Clawd types on a tiny laptop under the spinner: the code Claude writes floats out of the screen, input tokens float in, and he turns to face you while thinking.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: /image-preview opens a pane listing every image of the session, pasted or returned by a tool, and shows the one you pick.
